dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and symmetrical reduction in width from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white with subtle blue-grey tonality influenced by water depth.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Multiple fine, white linear marks consistent with healed rake marks visible on the central and left dorsal surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of several thin, elongated white linear scars across the mid-dorsal region.
